data.one_liner: Receive dragged files, directories, text, and URLs into Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to accept drag-and-drop operations for files, directories, text, and URLs. Provides configurable drop targets with support for MIME-type filtering, custom acceptance logic, and cross-platform native integration.
use_when: Building desktop or multi-platform apps that need to accept dragged files
Implementing custom file drop zones with specific MIME-type requirements
avoid_when: You only need a traditional file picker dialog rather than drag-and-drop
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, Linux, Web, Android, and iOS
Typed drop items for files, directories, and strings with MIME type info
Per-target drag acceptance and nested target fallback support
weaknesses: Provider access and temporary files are strictly bound to the lifetime of the onDrop callback
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.47.7 / Dart 3.13.5 or later. For macOS secondary windows using desktop_multi_window, manual plugin registration is needed.
